input.summary: Dairy Chiller at Ikeja Depot Shop: 2 of 6 planogram SKUs stocked out (compliance 67%), planogram share 100%, no unknown products. Peak Evaporated Milk 160g (0 of 3 facings) and Hollandia Yoghurt 1L (0 of 4 facings) are both empty on shelf, but inventory shows 13 and 10 units on hand respectively, each above their reorder point of 6. This is therefore a shelf-refill problem, not a supply problem — no purchase orders were raised. A manager has been notified by WhatsApp with the specific refill quantities (fill Peak Evap to 9 units/3 facings; put all 10 Hollandia units out to cover 4 facings). The remaining four SKUs are at expected facings and need no action. No telemetry was available and no equipment fault was reported, so no technician was dispatched; the note to the manager asks them to sanity-check the chiller temperature given the dairy draw-down. Audit confidence was 0.77 (moderate) and the auditor note simply read "refill", consistent with what inventory shows, so no escalation is needed. Follow-up: Hollandia Yoghurt 1L will sit at about its reorder point once shelved and should be included in the next order cycle.
